verdict.rationale: Folk documents custom object types defined inside a group, such as Projects, Job Applications, and Partnerships. They are read and written through dedicated custom object API endpoints, and the feature is on a paid pricing tier. The evidence does not show how fields on custom objects are defined, and it never mentions relationships between custom objects and other records. Custom fields are only documented for people and companies. Missing for 10: documented field schema for custom objects, relationship/link modeling between objects, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals

citations.quote: A custom object is a record of an object type defined inside a group: Deals, Projects, Job Applications, Partnerships, or anything else your workflow needs.
Deals are read and written with the custom object endpoints, with `Deals` as the `objectType` path parameter.
Custom fields are used to add additional information to people and companies inside a group.
